$comment: www.tizcat.com's pages. Each page is one file in pages\ holding only its content; layout.html wraps it (header, menu, footer) and css\site.css styles everything. To add a page: write pages\<name>.html and add it to "pages" (and to "menu" or a "footer" column if it should be linked there). To redesign: change layout.html and css\site.css. Then: servers\scripts\deploy.ps1 web. Raise assetVersion when css, js or images change, so browsers fetch the new ones. "moved" sends an old page address to its new one for good (301), so old links keep working.
